# Maui Mini Session

> Express 20-minute portrait sessions in Wailea and South Maui, from $299. Run by the Balter family, the same family behind Wailea Photo (https://waileaphoto.com).

## About
- Address: 3704 S Kihei Rd, Kihei, HI 96753
- Phone: +1-808-298-5188
- Email: info@mauiminisession.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mauiminisession
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mauiminisession
- Family-run for 25+ years; every session shot by the Balter family's own team, never an outside contractor. Images are naturally edited (no AI editing), delivered in 24-48 hours.
- Parent studio: Wailea Photo (https://waileaphoto.com) - full-length family, couples and wedding photography, with 4,500+ sessions completed.

## Sessions & Pricing
Each session is 20 minutes, includes 25+ edited high-resolution images, and covers up to five people (additional guests priced on the live booking calendar).
- Morning Mini Session - from $299. Soft morning light, cooler temperatures, quieter beach - good for early risers still adjusting to Hawaii time, especially with young children.
- Sunset Mini Session - from $299. Warm evening light, ocean color and the possibility of a dramatic Maui sunset.
- Turquoise Mini Session - from $299. Bright water and tropical color - a vivid alternative to sunrise or sunset portraits.
Live calendar and current pricing: https://mauiminisession.com/#sessions

## Guides
- What to wear: soft neutrals, whites, cream, sky blues, muted earth tones; avoid heavy logos, matching uniforms and neon colors - full guide from parent studio Wailea Photo: https://waileaphoto.com/what-to-wear-maui-photos
- Best time of day and location guides (The Atlas): https://waileaphoto.com/atlas
